I am too old to carry heavy fertilizer from the market, and this small plot is not worth such expense. We use manure from our animals to feed the soil, and we sow seeds saved from last season because they are free and familiar to us. My children and grandchildren will help me with the planting and weeding, but we have no money to hire workers from outside. We depend on the rains God provides, so we do not irrigate.
